scope: Verify the latest-master Issue 785 Android paired integration harness waits through an early Activity resume while its control file remains ready, then checks background RTP and same-room recovery.

source.note: The test ran with this worktree's resume-control wait patch atop current master. Focused unit tests passed 3/3. Product code was not modified.

early_resume.trigger: ADB am start ru.boohtacord.app/.MainActivity before the runner's scheduled 120-second resume; this was an Activity launch, not a notification tap.
early_resume.control_wait_behavior: The app may resume while the runner control is still ready; the test waits for the later resume command.
early_resume.post_notifications: Denied after the integration APK install, so no microphone notification row was available in this run.

background_and_resume.visual_observation: At source resolution the resumed Flutter screen showed the same connected voice channel and two participants; no clipping was visible in the captured state. This screenshot does not prove the exact notification tap path.

raw_local_artifacts.retention: Screenshots and raw .out results/logs are local runtime artifacts and are not committed.

limitations: This is an API 35 AOSP AVD result, not physical-device acceptance; the connected Pixel was not used.

This latest-master run resumed MainActivity directly; actual notification visibility and tap were exercised in a separate successful AVD run documented in issue785-android-notification-tap-recovery-avd-2026-11-22.json.
The microphone permission prompt, human permission choice, RTP intelligibility and audible output were not tested.
Secure keyguard, Android API 33/34, iOS, physical audio routing, silent network outage, release APK and production smoke remain open.
Issue 785 remains open; this scoped emulator result does not close the release gate.
